description: Workflow tests for the expo-app-filing skill. Each scenario checks that the agent follows the EAS APP filing workflow without leaking secrets or using debug credentials.

assertion_types.contains: substring must appear in transcript (case-sensitive by default)
assertion_types.matches: regex must match transcript at least once
assertion_types.absent: substring must NOT appear in transcript

scenarios.title: User needs APP filing public keys and fingerprints
scenarios.prompt: 我的 Expo app 要做 APP备案，帮我拿 iOS 的公钥/SHA1 和安卓的公钥/MD5。项目已经用 EAS。

assertions.name: uses-eas-credentials
assertions.rationale: The skill should route through EAS build credentials.

assertions.name: mentions-ios-distribution-certificate
assertions.rationale: iOS filing fields must come from the distribution certificate.

assertions.name: mentions-android-release-keystore
assertions.rationale: Android filing fields must come from the release keystore.

assertions.name: avoids-debug-keystore
assertions.rationale: Debug credentials must not be used for filing.

scenarios.title: EAS project prompts under the wrong owner
scenarios.prompt: eas credentials -p ios 提示要创建 @personal/my-app，但这个项目应该在公司 org 下面。怎么办？

assertions.name: adds-owner-before-eas-init
assertions.rationale: The skill should tell the agent to set Expo owner before accepting project creation.

assertions.name: confirms-eas-project-info
assertions.rationale: The agent should verify the project binding after init.

assertions.name: does-not-accept-personal-project
assertions.rationale: The agent should not suggest accepting the wrong personal project.

scenarios.title: User downloaded EAS credentials and wants extraction
scenarios.prompt: EAS 的 credentials.json、dist-cert.p12、keystore.jks 都下载下来了。怎么一键输出备案要填的 Bundle ID、包名、公钥和指纹？

assertions.name: uses-bundled-script
assertions.rationale: Downloaded credentials should be handled by the bundled extraction script.

assertions.name: prints-safe-fields
assertions.rationale: The script output fields should be named clearly.

assertions.name: does-not-print-secrets
assertions.value: (Never print|不要打印|不打印).*(password|private key|私钥|credentials\.json)
assertions.rationale: The workflow must preserve credential secrecy.
